name: James Sanders Jr.

sponsored.t: Requires the collection of certain demographic information by state agencies, boards, departments and commissions
sponsored.sum: Requires the collection of certain demographic information by state agencies, boards, departments and commissions.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of banks to promulgate rules and regulations requiring licensed cashers of checks to file suspicious activity reports
sponsored.sum: Directs the superintendent of banks to promulgate rules and regulations requiring licensed cashers of checks to file suspicious activity reports.
sponsored.fis: this bill should increase tax revenue by aiding investigators in crack- ing down on fraud and tax evasion committed by customers of check cash- ers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to commercial financing
sponsored.sum: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to commercial financing; provides that liability shall not be imposed on a provider if the actual annual percentage rate charged by the provider differs from the estimated annual percentage rate disclosed by the provider acting in good faith.

sponsored.t: Relates to asset-based lending transactions
sponsored.sum: Deems asset-based lending transactions to be loans for all purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small business enterprises where there is privity of contract between a small business enterprise and a subcontractor or contractor working on an authority public works contract.
sponsored.fis: May have minimal administrative costs, with potential funding through existing state business development programs or public-private partner- ships.

sponsored.t: Requires certain establishments provide tap water on request
sponsored.sum: Requires certain establishments provide tap water on request.

sponsored.t: Relates to reciprocity between the state and New York city for businesses that are certified as minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the director of the division of minority and women's business development and the mayor of the city of New York to enter into a memorandum of understanding to allow reciprocity between the state and New York City for businesses that are certified as minority and women-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded
sponsored.sum: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded; mandates that the prime contractor use such enterprise identified on the utilization plan, unless such enterprise cannot perform or is no longer state certified.

sponsored.t: Relates to crypto kiosks
sponsored.sum: Provides for the registration and regulation of crypto kiosks and exchanges and licensing of cashier crypto exchange operators.

sponsored.t: Relates to a deposit placement program for the Banking Development District Program
sponsored.sum: Allows a bank, in the discretion of the comptroller and the commissioner of taxation and finance, to arrange for the redeposit of moneys, in whole or in part, through a deposit placement program.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of the state charter advisory board
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of the state charter advisory board.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Sickle Cell Treatment Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Sickle Cell Treatment Act" which designates sickle cell centers for excellence and outpatient treatment centers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study on the formation and control of a state public bank
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study to evaluate and make recommendations concerning the formation and control of a state public bank; provides if such study finds that the state bank is feasible, the commission may recommend legislation to create a state public bank for New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to construction and mentoring programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to construction and mentoring programs; provides that any agency may establish a mentoring program for small businesses that perform construction or architectural or engineering services related to construction.

sponsored.t: Relates to solid waste removal invoices and directs certain penalties and fines related to such invoices to be deposited into the environmental protection fund
sponsored.sum: Requires any waste hauler providing waste removal services to provide to customers certain estimated costs and invoices; includes penalties for initial and subsequent violations; requires moneys collected from penalties and fines to be deposited into the environmental protection fund.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the banking development district program and to make recommendations to improve such program
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the banking development district program and to make recommendations to improve such program.

sponsored.t: Establishes September twenty-second of each year as a day of commemoration known as Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Day
sponsored.sum: Establishes September twenty-second of each year as a day of commemoration known as Veteran Suicide Awareness and Remembrance Day.

sponsored.t: Requires an annual report on state agency utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires an annual report on state agency utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises detailing expenditure totals and percentages and whether agency MWBE participation goals were achieved.

sponsored.t: Authorizes agencies to procure goods, services and construction from special veteran emerging business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes agencies to procure goods, services and construction from special veteran emerging business enterprises; defines special veteran emerging business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Requires covered lenders to report to the department of financial services certain information on covered loans
sponsored.sum: Requires covered lenders to report to the department of financial services certain information on covered loans; requires the superintendent of financial services to collect and maintain such data and to annually publish a report containing aggregated information regarding covered loans; requires the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations to implement such provisions.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Port Authority Police Officer Arthur M. Ansert Jr.
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on the South Service Road, between Federal Circle and Perimeter Road Overpass, crossing over the Van Wyck Expressway in Jamaica to Port Authority Police Officer Arthur M. Ansert Jr.

sponsored.t: Relation to the regulation of the use of artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to promulgate a written protocol for the regulation of the use of artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits solid waste polluters from procuring solid waste public contracts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain solid waste polluters from procuring public contracts for certain periods of time after violations and until all debts to the state are satisfied; prohibits individuals found guilty of solid waste pollution from serving as members of any board of any entity engaged in solid waste removal and disposal.

sponsored.t: Requires that public contracts be divided by size into large, medium, small and micro contracts for the purpose of increasing opportunities for small businesses, including MWBEs, to participate in state contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires that public contracts be divided by size into large, medium, small and micro contracts for the purpose of increasing opportunities for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned business enterprises, to participate in state contracts.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue certain parkland in the borough of Queens
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue certain parkland in the borough of Queens and transfer such parkland to the metropolitan transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation in state contracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements
sponsored.sum: Relates to increased participation in state contracts and subcontracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; requires quarterly reports from contracting agencies; addresses consequences if contracting agency fails to comply with reporting requirements; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements.

sponsored.t: Defines satisfaction of judgment and authorizing satisfactions to be filed on affirmation
sponsored.sum: Defines the term "satisfaction" in relation to the satisfaction of judgments; allows satisfaction of judgments to be filed by affirmation rather than after notarization; increases the time during which attorneys may file satisfaction of judgment from ten to twenty years; clarifies that the twenty-day time limit applicable to filing satisfactions of judgment is measured in business days.

sponsored.t: Requires mental health evaluations for participants in substance use disorder treatment programs
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports to require mental health evaluations for participants in substance use disorder treatment programs and to promulgate rules and regulations to effectuate such requirement.

sponsored.t: Enacts the towing protection enforcement act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the towing protection enforcement act; updates laws that regulate the towing of vehicles, including adding provisions thereto to prevent predatory towing of vehicles within the City of New York.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Any costs associated with the conducting of hearings by the tow advisory board.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system for P'nina Gluck
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system for P'nina Gluck.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of automated lending decision-making tools by banks for the purposes of making lending decisions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of automated lending decision-making tools by banks for the purposes of making lending decisions; allows loan applicants to consent to or opt out of such use.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the central air conditioner and heat pump rights act
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the central air conditioner and heat pump rights act; provides that a homeowners' association may not adopt or enforce any rules or regulations that would effectively prohibit, or impose unreasonable limitations on, the installation or use of a central air conditioner or heat pump.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the inclusion of a confession of judgment in a contract or agreement for a financial product or service
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the inclusion of a confession of judgment in a contract or agreement for a financial product or service.

sponsored.t: Directs the city of New York to conduct an analysis of stormwater and groundwater issues in southeast Queens
sponsored.sum: Directs the city of New York to conduct an analysis of stormwater and groundwater issues in southeast Queens.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fees for any service rendered through a bank relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the imposition of fees or surcharges for any service rendered through a banking organization relating to the use of an electronic benefit transfer card issued by the state or certain departments or agencies thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to a minority and women-owned business enterprise participation goal requirement in order to receive grant or appropriation money
sponsored.sum: Relates to a minority and women-owned business enterprise participation goal requirement in order to receive grant or appropriation money.

sponsored.t: Provides for elder abuse prevention training
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for the aging to develop and provide elder abuse prevention training to train senior service centers and entities that contract with the office for the aging and the office of children and family services to provide services to elderly persons in the detection and reporting of elder abuse in consultation with the office of children and family services.

sponsored.t: Establishes mandatory minimum medicaid coverage for hospital confinement for childbirth
sponsored.sum: Requires all insurance policies and health maintenance organization contracts to provide coverage for maternity patients and their newborns for hospital stays of at least 48 hours following childbirth by natural delivery and 96 hours following childbirth by caesarean section; provides such coverage for patients who are recipients of medicaid.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic delivery of insurance notices
sponsored.sum: Allows for certain notices related to property/casualty insurance contracts under the vehicle and traffic law to be delivered by electronic means.

sponsored.t: Prevents fraudulent deed transfers
sponsored.sum: Relates to preventing fraudulent deed transfers; protects home owners from being misled into transferring their home to mortgage servicers.
sponsored.fis: There is no fiscal impact to the State but may generate revenue for the state in the form of fines.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding certain notice requirements for enforcing liens on goods in self-storage facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding certain notice requirements for enforcing liens on goods in self-storage facilities.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the eviction of tenants for using medical marihuana for a certified medical use
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the eviction of tenants for using medical marihuana for a certified medical use.

sponsored.t: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the senate to four years
sponsored.sum: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the senate to four years.

sponsored.t: Relates to informal caregiver training
sponsored.sum: Relates to informal caregiver training; defines "person in need of assistance"; expands who may serve as an "informal caregiver".

sponsored.t: Enacts the "facial recognition technology study act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "facial recognition technology study act" to study privacy concerns and potential regulatory approaches to the development of facial recognition technology.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of coal tar and its use in pavement products
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of coal tar and its use in pavement products.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting of climate-related financial risk
sponsored.sum: Requires reporting of climate-related financial risk by certain entities; defines climate-related financial risk to mean material harm to financial outcomes of the entity due to physical and transition risks.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a task force on safety in school transportation
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a task force on safety in school transportation to review and promote such safety.

sponsored.t: Relates to legislator compensation
sponsored.sum: Raises legislator compensation to $180,000 beginning January 1, 2028, each year thereafter such salary shall be increased equal to the percentage increase, if any, in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (CPI-U).

sponsored.t: Creates a banking development district working group
sponsored.sum: Creates a banking development district working group to assess the banking development district program and provide an annual report to the governor and legislature on the strengths and weaknesses of such program; defines unbanked and underbanked.

sponsored.t: Regulates commercial finance licensing
sponsored.sum: Regulates commercial finance licensing; sets forth the application process for such licensing; makes conforming technical changes thereto.
sponsored.fis: No net cost to the State. The Department of Financial Services would collect licensing fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to minority depository institutions which apply to establish a home or branch office in an unbanked or underbanked community
sponsored.sum: Relates to minority depository institutions which apply to establish a home or branch office in an unbanked or underbanked community; provides that such institutions shall be entitled to receive deposits from the state comptroller and the commissioner of taxation and finance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prevention and mitigation of marine and coastal debris
sponsored.sum: Relates to the prevention and mitigation of marine and coastal debris; defines terms; requires the department of environmental conservation to prepare and annually update a marine and coastal debris action plan.

sponsored.t: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property
sponsored.sum: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property when covenants, conditions and restrictions exist which discriminate on the basis of a protected class in violation of state or federal law.

sponsored.t: Defines "employer" for purposes of the fair credit reporting act; relates to the requesting or use for employment purposes of the consumer credit history of an applicant for employment or employee; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of consumer credit history in hiring, employment and licensing determinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to computer-related crimes
sponsored.sum: Relates to computer-related crimes; creates the crimes unlawful disruption of computer services in the first and second degree, unlawful computer access assistance in the first and second degree, unauthorized use of internet domain name or profile, and unlawful introduction of a computer contaminant; allows for a civil action for compensatory damages for victims of such crimes.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fund for the creation of affordable housing
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fund for the creation of affordable housing for veterans and seniors.

sponsored.t: Subsidizes closing costs for low income current tenants who are purchasing a home
sponsored.sum: Calls for the state to subsidize a portion of closing costs for certain individuals who have been tenants of public housing projects or rent subsidized housing for the previous five years.

sponsored.t: Requires that thirty percent of state agency property management contracts be awarded to minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires that each agency letting contracts for the hiring of property managers for residential and commercial buildings structure procurement goals for such contracts that include the award of thirty percent of such contracts to minority and women-owned business enterprises; provides for the promulgation of rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Provides retroactivity to the original date of eligibility in certain cases for the senior citizens rent increase exemption (SCRIE) and disability rent increase exemption (DRIE)
sponsored.sum: Provides retroactivity to the original date of eligibility for the senior citizens rent increase exemption (SCRIE) and disability rent increase exemption (DRIE).

sponsored.t: Relates to the community bank deposit program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the community bank deposit program; increases the maximum amount of funds on deposit at a community banking institution to thirty million dollars.

sponsored.t: Amends the constitution to provide for an economic bill of rights for the citizens of the state
sponsored.sum: Amends the constitution to provide for an economic bill of rights for the citizens of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to transfer of sick time
sponsored.sum: Allows certain employees to transfer or receive sick time from a fellow employee.

sponsored.t: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a returning veterans tax credit for businesses that hire veterans and disabled veterans; provides that such tax credit is worth $3,000 per veteran hired or $4,000 for every disabled veteran hired and the total benefit shall not exceed $15,000 annually.

sponsored.t: Waives state's sovereign immunity in state and federal courts with regard to liability under the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 and certain other federal acts
sponsored.sum: Waives the state's sovereign immunity in state and federal courts with regard to liability for violations of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, the Fair Labor Standards Act, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act, and the Family and Medical Leave Act; waives the immunity of all instrumentalities and political subdivisions of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time to file a claim in a toxic tort case
sponsored.sum: Provides that in toxic tort cases the date of discovery of the injury by the plaintiff or claimant is presumed to be the date of diagnosis and where the specific toxic etiological cause of injury is not known for up to ten years (instead of five years) after the injury itself is discovered a plaintiff shall have three years to file a claim from the time such specific cause is discovered.

sponsored.t: Establishes the municipal severe storm relief fund for Rockaway, Queens to be administered by the division of homeland security
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the municipal severe storm relief fund for Rockaway, Queens to be administered by the division of homeland security and emergency services for damages that occurred as a result of Hurricane Sandy which caused damage from October twenty-ninth through November third, two thousand twelve.

sponsored.t: Requires diversity, inclusion and elimination of bias training for certain medical personnel as part of continuing medical education requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires diversity, inclusion and elimination of bias training for physicians, physician assistants and nurses as part of continuing medical education requirements; establishes such training shall be a biennial requirement.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of funding permissible for the investment in a cannabis private debt or equity fund
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of funding permissible for the investment in a cannabis private debt or equity fund to $300,000,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to rebates for stock transfer tax paid; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the rebates for stock transfer tax paid; dedicates funds of the stock transfer tax fund and stock transfer incentive fund to various funds; establishes the safe water and infrastructure action program.
sponsored.fis: Up to $60 billion in revenue to New York State

sponsored.t: Relates to providing increased and uniform training requirements and outreach for law enforcement and establishes law enforcement peer support
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing increased and uniform training requirements including implicit bias, use of force, first aid and firearm training, and outreach for law enforcement; establishes law enforcement peer support through the office of mental health.
sponsored.fis: To be determined by the law enforcement agencies as set forth by the legislation.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "police and peace officer licensing act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "police and peace officer licensing act", which includes continuing education programs for new and current police and peace officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the execution of a warrant of arrest and establishes educational programs for judicial personnel on the law of searches, arrests and seizures
sponsored.sum: Relates to the execution of a warrant of arrest; authorizes the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to establish a system to record and monitor the issuance and execution of search warrants; authorizes the chief administrator of the court system to establish educational programs for judicial personnel on the law of searches, arrests and seizures.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Cariol's Law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Cariol's Law"; provides for a duty to intervene when a police officer or peace officer observes another police officer or peace officer using physical force that such officer reasonably believes to be clearly excessive or beyond that which is objectively reasonable under the circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requires grand jury proceedings for police officers or peace officers involved in a shooting or excessive use of force to be conducted in open, contemporaneous public hearings
sponsored.sum: Requires grand jury proceedings for police officers or peace officers involved in a shooting or excessive use of force to be conducted in open, contemporaneous public hearings.

sponsored.t: Establishes a statewide law enforcement officer misconduct database
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of criminal justice services to establish a statewide public database covering every local police department, each county sheriff's office, the division of the state police and every agency that employs a peace officer in this state, which shall compile the names of any police or peace officer who has had their employment terminated due to misconduct.

sponsored.t: Establishes a special prosecutor to investigate and prosecute matters involving the death of an unarmed civilian caused by a law enforcement officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes a special prosecutor to investigate and prosecute matters involving the death of an unarmed civilian caused by a law enforcement officer.

sponsored.t: Establishes a civil cause of action for employees who are subjected to an abusive work environment
sponsored.sum: Establishes a civil cause of action for employees who are subjected to an abusive work environment; provides employers shall be vicariously liable for such work environment.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Malcolm X unsolved civil rights crime act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Malcom X unsolved civil rights crime act"; requires the assistant attorney of the civil rights bureau to investigate violations of criminal civil rights statutes that occurred not later than December thirty-first, nineteen seventy-nine, and resulted in a death.

sponsored.t: Relates to including information concerning repayment of outstanding loans in the standard financial aid award letter
sponsored.sum: Relates to including information concerning repayment of outstanding loans in the standard financial aid award letter.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "New York public banking act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York public banking act"; authorizes municipal and other local governments to form and control public banks through the ownership of capital stock or other ownership interests, and to loan or grant public funds or lend public credit to such public banks for the public purposes of achieving cost savings, strengthening local economies, supporting community economic development, and addressing infrastructure and housing needs for localities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "climate safe & responsible bank procurement act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "climate safe and responsible bank procurement act", which creates standards for the purchasing of bank services.

sponsored.t: Establishes representative requirements for district leadership teams and school leadership teams
sponsored.sum: Requires district leadership teams and school leadership teams to include student representatives; provides who should appoint such representatives.

sponsored.t: Requires district leadership teams to operate under open meetings law requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires district leadership teams to operate under open meetings law requirements.

sponsored.t: Allows credit unions, savings banks, savings and loan associations and federal savings associations to accept and secure deposits from municipal corporations
sponsored.sum: Allows credit unions, savings banks, savings and loan associations and federal savings associations to accept and secure deposits from municipal corporations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the citywide leadership team; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the citywide leadership team to ensure that parents' and students' voices are represented in all education decision-making, ensure education policies considered or implemented are conducive to promoting student achievement and enhancing the overall quality of education for students attending public schools in the city of New York, and include all stakeholders at all stages of the decision-making process.

sponsored.t: Establishes the state financial literacy fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the state financial literacy fund which provides funding for project grants to organizations in order to establish financial capability and financial literacy programs, products content and/or services for at-risk populations in New York.
sponsored.fis: The attorney general shall transfer a sum up to $1 million annually, subject to available funding.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for the sale and installation of residential and commercial geothermal heat pump systems equipment
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the sale and installation of residential and commercial geothermal heat pump systems equipment.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a study on domestic terrorism within the state and to make recommendations to address such terrorism
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a study on domestic terrorism within the state and to make recommendations to address such terrorism.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fuel cell incentive program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fuel cell incentive program to be managed by NYSERDA to encourage development of fuel cell generating systems.
sponsored.fis: The yearly costs of the program are $65 million combined to the state; however, NYSERDA makes off-budget collections of almost $1 billion. As such there is not direct fiscal impact on the state operating budget.

sponsored.t: Establishes a community wind energy pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a community wind energy pilot program; creates an investor owned wind energy electric generating system.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a person convicted of rebellion or insurrection from state or municipal employment
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a person convicted of rebellion or insurrection under federal law from state or municipal employment.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all banking organizations to have a notary public available during business hours
sponsored.sum: Requires all banking organizations to have a notary public available during business hours; permits banking organizations to charge a fee for such service.

sponsored.t: Establishes the work opportunity tax credit for businesses with fifty employees or less for hiring a long term unemployed person
sponsored.sum: Establishes the work opportunity tax credit for businesses with fifty employees or less for hiring a long term unemployed person; provides a credit shall be allowed of up to $2,400; provides the total amount of credit provided statewide shall not exceed fifteen million dollars.
sponsored.fis: The total amount of the state tax credit is capped at $15 million in the aggregate in a taxable year beginning January 1, 2020.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of the New York state promise program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of the New York state promise program for community college courses; makes an appropriation therefor.
sponsored.fis: $450,000,000.00 appropriation, or so much thereof as may be necessary

sponsored.t: Requires the state university of New York and the city university of New York to examine and conduct a study on the availability of campus services, programs and resources for veteran students
sponsored.sum: Requires the state university of New York and the city university of New York to examine and conduct a study on the availability of campus services, programs and resources for veteran students.

sponsored.t: Allows for reimbursement of transportation costs for emergency care without prior authorization by the social services official
sponsored.sum: Allows for reimbursement of transportation costs for emergency care without prior authorization by the social services official including emergency medical transportation by an ambulance service certified under article 30 of the public health law; authorizes the commissioner of health to establish a reimbursement methodology to ensure providers are reimbursed.
sponsored.fis: Dependent on the costs of transporting patients. The State would also assume the local share of any additional Medicaid spending.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission to study sexual misconduct in state correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate sexual misconduct in state correctional facilities among incarcerated individuals and employees; devises a reporting system for notification of such misconduct to appropriate authorities; establishes duties and membership of such commission.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of corrections and community supervision to conduct a comprehensive study on deaths in correctional facilities within New York state
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of corrections and community supervision to conduct a comprehensive study on deaths in correctional facilities within New York state to provide data-driven insights and recommendations to improve prison conditions, healthcare, and policies to prevent future tragedies.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain discriminatory practices; and to the qualification of professionals in education
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain discriminatory practices; relates to the qualification of professionals in education; provides for the tolling of certain statutes of limitations; provides a private cause of action for a person who is qualified for a public contract who has been deprived of equal opportunity to such public contract.

sponsored.t: Establishes the state of New York public bank
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the state of New York public bank to use the state's depository assets to generate additional benefit for the people and the economy of the state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state money transmission disclosure act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state money transmission disclosure act; requires each licensee providing a transmission transaction which involves currency of one country into the currency of another country to provide the customer with a written disclosure; authorizes the superintendent of financial services to implement any necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Establishes standards for the closure of banking accounts in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for the closure of bank accounts in the state of New York to include providing notice of closure and the return of funds to account owners.

sponsored.t: Allows for mortgagors to cancel or renegotiate forbearance agreements made during a state disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Allows for mortgagors to cancel or renegotiate forbearance agreements made during a state disaster emergency.

sponsored.t: Provides for the regulation of buy-now-pay-later lenders
sponsored.sum: Provides for the regulation of buy-now-pay-later lenders; requires such lenders to be licensed; establishes prohibited acts, limitations on loans, and consumer protections.

sponsored.t: Establishes the college of renewable energy and sustainability in the city university of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes the college of renewable energy and sustainability in the city university of New York which shall offer majors relating to the field of renewable energy and sustainability.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state officers and employees from official involvement with a state project where the officer or employee acted as a consultant on such project
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state officers and employees from official involvement with a state project where the officer or employee acted as a consultant on such project.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the "small contractors relief act"; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small contractors relief act; creates the New York small contractor safety group, inc. pilot program; appropriates money therefor.
sponsored.fis: The sum of $25,000,000, or so much thereof as may be necessary, shall be appropriated from any monies in the State Treasury in the General Fund to the credit of the State Purposes Account not otherwise appropriated to the State Insurance Fund for the initial capital of the Safety Group Fund in carrying out the provisions of this act.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of certain public employee retirees
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the diminution of health insurance benefits of public employee retirees and their dependents or reducing the employer's contributions for such insurance; defines employers to include the state, municipalities, school districts, and public authorities and commissions.
sponsored.fis: No new costs to state government. This legislation simply continues the benefits and employer contributions being made as of May 1, 2008.

sponsored.t: Requires state and municipal agencies to purchase compostable single use tableware
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring state and municipal agencies to purchase compostable single use tableware; requires state and municipal agencies purchasing single use tableware to purchase single use tableware made from material that is compostable unless there is no affordable compostable product available.

sponsored.t: Requires certain information be made available to elected officials prior to funding reductions for hospitals and nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Requires any information or data produced internally or by an outside consultant used by the governor, the division of the budget, the department of health or any other relevant state agency to justify such reduction be made available to elected officials prior to funding reductions for hospitals and nursing homes.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting on swimming education in a public school
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education to make a report on the extent of all existing resources and best practices available for swimming instruction classes in public schools and establish a working group on swimming education.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state commission on economic inequality, equal opportunity, and competitiveness
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state commission on economic inequality, equal opportunity, and competitiveness; provides such commission shall investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning how to work toward reducing economic inequality, eliminating poverty, achieving equal opportunity and full employment, and boosting economic competitiveness and growth.

sponsored.t: Relates to training requirements for attorneys appointed to represent a child in certain proceedings
sponsored.sum: Relates to training requirements for attorneys appointed to represent a child in certain proceedings.

sponsored.t: Requires a purchaser of any firearm, rifle or shotgun to submit to a mental health evaluation
sponsored.sum: Requires a purchaser of any firearm, rifle or shotgun to submit to a mental health evaluation and provide the seller with such purchaser's approval to purchase such firearm.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Destini Smothers' law"; requires collaboration between law enforcement agencies in missing persons investigations and provides support for relatives of such missing persons
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Destini Smothers' law"; requires collaboration between law enforcement agencies in missing persons investigations; provides support for relatives of such missing persons.

sponsored.t: Relates to declaring a climate emergency and placing a ban on new fossil fuel infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Declares a climate emergency and places a ban on fossil fuel infrastructure projects but shall not apply to repair or maintenance of existing infrastructure.
sponsored.fis: This bill is anticipated to result in net savings over time when all internal and external costs are considered.

sponsored.t: Alters tax exemption programs for the development of new and affordable housing
sponsored.sum: Alters tax exemption programs for the development of new and affordable housing; defines "initial construction period" and "extended construction period"; makes related changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the issuance of late fees prior to a finding of liability; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the issuance of late fees prior to a finding of liability.

sponsored.t: Provides the option for candidates for office and petition witnesses not to put their address on designation petitions
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the "Esther Salas candidate privacy act" providing the option for candidates for office and petition witnesses not to put their address on designation petitions but instead file such with the county clerk for a fee.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the manufacturing development zone program and tax credits related thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the manufacturing development zone program and tax credits related thereto.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York state department of financial services to oversee the planned closing of bank branch offices by federally chartered banking organizations
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state department of financial services to oversee the planned closing of bank branch offices by federally chartered banking organizations.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of summonses to parents of any juvenile who is the subject of a juvenile delinquency petition
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of summonses to each parent, including a non-custodial parent, of any juvenile who is the subject of a juvenile delinquency petition.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting the acquisition of a rifle or shotgun to one per ninety-day period
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting the acquisition of a rifle or shotgun to one per ninety-day period.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to make efforts to reduce incarcerated individual telephone rates and to place a cap on the cost of outgoing calls
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to make efforts to reduce incarcerated individual telephone rates and to place a cap on the cost of outgoing calls.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Kelsey Smith Act to require wireless service providers to provide call location information to law enforcement during an emergency
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Kelsey Smith Act to require wireless service providers to provide call location information to law enforcement during an emergency.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York Data Protection Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York Data Protection Act; requires government entities and contractors to disclose certain personal information collected about individuals.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "New York municipal asset forfeiture accountability act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York municipal asset forfeiture accountability act" which requires that all funds lawfully seized by a county sheriff or other municipal police agency shall go to such municipalities' general fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York city housing authority and mold remediation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the New York city housing authority and mold remediation; establishes after reporting such authority shall have 15 days to remediate such reported mold.

sponsored.t: Permits a potential lottery winner who lost their ticket to claim the winning amount
sponsored.sum: Permits a potential lottery winner who lost their ticket to claim the winning amount provided that such person shows the lottery agency documentary proof of purchase of the winning ticket within one year of the winning date.
sponsored.fis: There is no fiscal impact to the State.

sponsored.t: Requires contractors in certain large cities to recycle 50% of the waste generated on construction and demolition sites
sponsored.sum: Requires contractors in cities having a population of one million or more to recycle 50% of the waste generated on construction and demolition sites.
sponsored.fis: The bill will have minimum administrative impacts on New York City.

sponsored.t: Limits the amount of certain credit service charges in motor vehicle retail installment contracts
sponsored.sum: Limits the amount of certain credit service charges in motor vehicle retail installment contracts.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "home mortgage bridge loan assistance act "
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "home mortgage bridge loan assistance act" to prevent avoidable home mortgage foreclosures by providing temporary bridge loan assistance; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: It is estimated that the Home Mortgage Bridge Loan Assistance Program will require startup funding of up to approximately $130 million, depending upon how many mortgagors qualify, when the respective loans are originated, and what the respective loan terms are. Thereafter, the Program will be funded with (1) all moneys paid by mortgagors in repay- ment of home mortgage bridge loan assistance payments made on their behalves; (2) state appropriations, in an amount to be determined and to the extent the Program has not become fully self-funding; (3) any grant or other provision of funds by a financial institution for the purpose of receiving Community Reinvestment Act credit; (4) any contributions made by business firms or other entities to the Program in return for tax credits, to the extent such tax credits are available; and (5) any contributions made by any other person or entity to…

sponsored.t: Creates the uniform trade secrets act
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the uniform trade secrets act.

sponsored.t: Establishes a COVID-19 essential workers scholarship program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a COVID-19 essential workers scholarship program to award annual scholarships to essential employees who worked during the outbreak of novel coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) and children of essential employees who have died as a result of contracting COVID-19.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of consent
sponsored.sum: Adds the definition of consent to the terms of general use; defines it as a freely given, knowledgeable and informed agreement by a person with the capacity to reason.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a pre-specialized high schools admissions test and preparation program
sponsored.sum: Creates a pre-specialized high schools admissions test and preparation program for all sixth grade students in New York city.

sponsored.t: Establishes the paired testing program, compliance fee and a paired testing program fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the paired testing program and compliance fee to determine if any real estate broker, real estate salesperson or employee or agent thereof is using unlawful discriminatory practices; creates the paired testing program fund.

sponsored.t: Provides line of duty sick leave for first responders who are diagnosed with or display symptoms of a pandemic virus
sponsored.sum: Provides line of duty sick leave for first responders who are diagnosed with or display symptoms of a pandemic virus.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for rest between work shifts
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing for rest between work shifts; prohibits the scheduling of an employee to work the first ten hours following the end of the previous calendar day's work shift or on-call shift or the first ten hours following the end of a work shift or on-call shift that spanned two calendar days unless an employee consents or volunteers, in which case the employee shall be paid one and one-half times the regular rate of pay.
sponsored.fis: Minor costs to the state for administration of this act, to be offset by civil penalties generated under this legislation.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain prohibitions in contracts or agreements by health maintenance organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain prohibitions in contracts or agreements by health maintenance organizations; prohibits clauses which entitle reimbursement at the lowest price or rate; prohibits contracts which restrict referral of patients based solely upon a health care provider's status with a managed care product; prohibits contracts which allow for the substitution of a pharmaceutical drug or agent by any person other than the prescribing health care professional.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain state regulated institutions to offer disaster forbearance agreements to qualified mortgagors
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain state regulated institutions to offer disaster forbearance agreements to qualified mortgagors whose income has been adversely affected by the outbreak of COVID-19 and is unable to make their mortgage payment.

sponsored.t: Requires a 60 day license suspension for any driver convicted of 2 speeding violations within a school zone, committed within an 18 month period of time
sponsored.sum: Requires a 60 day license suspension for any driver convicted of 2 speeding violations within a school zone, committed within an 18 month period of time.

sponsored.t: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application
sponsored.sum: Relates to an electronically submitted absentee ballot application.
sponsored.fis: Minimal to create electronic transmittal system. Cost savings to be realized from not paying postage to mail applications.

sponsored.t: Prohibits imposition of surcharges at automated teller machines on public university property
sponsored.sum: Prohibits imposing surcharges on automated teller machines located on state university of New York or city university of New York property.

sponsored.t: Establishes the JFK Innovation Center
sponsored.sum: Establishes the JFK Innovation Center to launch SmartCities and CleanTech innovations.

sponsored.t: Confinement of animals for food producing purposes
sponsored.sum: Pertains to confinement of animals for food producing purposes; prohibits any person to tether or confine any pig during pregnancy, calf raised for veal, or egg-laying hen who is kept on a farm for all or the majority of any day in a manner that prevents such animal from lying down, standing up and fully extending its limbs and turning around freely; establishes that commission of such crime shall constitute a class A misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a period not to exceed one year and/or fine not to exceed $1,000.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York slavery era business and state procurement disclosure act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York slavery era business and state procurement disclosure act"; requires insurers to report insurance policies issued to slaveholders during the slavery era that provided coverage for damage to or death to such slaveholders' slaves; requires contractors seeking to enter into or renew procurement contracts with state agencies to report slavery era financing, investments and profits of slavery.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Cannabis Community Reinvestment Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Cannabis Community Reinvestment Act; includes requirements for cannabis operators; includes the obligation to reinvest in communities disproportionately impacted by cannabis prohibition including, if applicable, the community such operator is located in; provides for the review of reinvestment plans by the department of financial services.

sponsored.t: Requires quarterly reporting on the amounts awarded and received from the opioid settlement fund
sponsored.sum: Requires quarterly reporting on the opioid settlement fund, including the names of the recipients and the amounts awarded and received.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "economic development performance review act"; directs state agencies to conduct annual comprehensive performance review of economic development activities
sponsored.sum: Enacts the economic development performance review act; prescribes the functions and purposes of the special evaluation program bond act; requires state agencies involved in economic development activities to prepare an annual comprehensive performance review of their programs.

sponsored.t: Requires the joint commission on public ethics to develop a campaign finance course and requiring all members of the legislature, staff treasurers and all individuals running for office to complete the course
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the joint commission on public ethics to develop and maintain a campaign finance training course; requires all members of the legislature, their staff treasurer and all individuals running for elected office to complete the campaign finance training course.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies and contractors to recycle 50% of the waste generated on public works construction and demolition sites
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies and contractors to recycle a certain percentage of the waste generated on public works construction and demolition sites.
sponsored.fis: The bill should have minimum administrative impacts on State and local government and in fact should reduce waste disposal costs.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance plans to provide coverage for epi-pens for individuals 18 years old and younger
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance plans to provide coverage for epi-pens for individuals 18 years old and younger.

sponsored.t: Relates to admission requirements for graduate-level teacher and educational leader programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to admission requirements for graduate-level teacher and educational leader programs.

sponsored.t: Provides for automatic issuance of identification cards to incarcerated individuals and assistance with obtaining copies of certain documents
sponsored.sum: Provides for automatic issuance of identification cards to incarcerated individuals and assistance with obtaining copies of any documents needed to apply for identification cards, including, but not limited to, an incarcerated individual's social security card and birth certificate.

sponsored.t: Requires that employees laid off due to the COVID-19 state disaster emergency retain their salary, seniority and benefits once rehired
sponsored.sum: Requires that employees laid off due to the COVID-19 state disaster emergency retain their salary, seniority and benefits once rehired.

sponsored.t: Limits the liability of a debit cardholder for unauthorized use of a debit card
sponsored.sum: Limits the liability of a debit cardholder for unauthorized use of a debit card.

sponsored.t: Relates to the expiration of right to collect consumer credit debt
sponsored.sum: Relates to the expiration of right to collect consumer credit debt; includes any attempts made by the creditor, third-party purchaser or other authorized third party to collect such debt.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate how to regulate artificial intelligence, robotics and automation; repeals such commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to primary elections in the city of New York; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires that elections for municipal office in the city of New York shall use an "instant run-off" or "ranked choice" voting system.
sponsored.fis: No cost to the State. Will save New York City the cost of running runoff elections, which cost $13 million in 2013.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to collect and report certain data concerning COVID 19
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to collect and report certain data concerning COVID-19 including racial, ethnic, and other demographic disparities throughout the state which are contributing to the amount of positive cases and the care provided for such.
sponsored.fis: This bill would use existing resources as well as an emergency appropri- ation from the state General Fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to expungement of records for certain juveniles convicted of a nonviolent offense after seven years
sponsored.sum: Relates to expungement of records for certain juveniles convicted of a nonviolent offense after seven years and satisfactory completion of such person's probation, parole, supervised release and payment of any fines imposed or restitution ordered, whichever is later.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unlawful use of a remotely piloted aircraft
sponsored.sum: Relates to the unlawful use of a remotely piloted aircraft; defines remotely piloted aircraft as a device used for flight in the air which is operated remotely without the possibility of direct human intervention from within or on the aircraft.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawful surveillance
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful surveillance; adds additional actions constituting unlawful surveillance in the second degree and in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring reporting and verification of greenhouse gas emissions by certain entities
sponsored.sum: Requires reporting and verification of scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas emissions by a business with total annual revenues in excess of one billion dollars ($1,000,000,000) that does business in New York; requires regulations and disclosures.

sponsored.t: Discrimination where insurers exclude, limit, restrict or reduce coverage of a publicly-assisted housing accommodation due to lawful source of income
sponsored.sum: Establishes discrimination where insurers exclude, limit, restrict or reduce coverage of a publicly-assisted housing accommodation due to lawful source of income.

sponsored.t: Prohibits unlawful hiring discrimination by employers and employment agencies based upon an individual's unemployment status
sponsored.sum: Prohibits unlawful hiring discrimination by employers and employment agencies based upon an individual's unemployment status including decisions with regard to hiring, compensation or the terms thereof, or conditions or privileges of employment.

sponsored.t: Requires bomb or blast resistant garbage receptacles in facilities of common carriers
sponsored.sum: Requires bomb or blast resistant garbage receptacles in facilities of common carriers; provides minimum specifications for such receptacles shall be set by the NYS division of homeland security and emergency services.

sponsored.t: Requires participation in an alcohol and drug rehabilitation program for certain first offenders
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring participation in an alcohol and drug rehabilitation program for certain first offenders.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain one or more independent MWBE consultant firms to conduct an independent review of procurement procedures utilized by state agencies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain one or more independent MWBE consultant firms to conduct an independent review of procurement procedures utilized by state agencies.

sponsored.t: Authorizes political subdivisions to award public contracts to participants of a MWBE program at a cost premium not to exceed ten percent of the lowest bid
sponsored.sum: Authorizes political subdivisions to award public contracts to participants of a minority and women owned business enterprise program at a cost premium not to exceed ten percent of the lowest bid.
sponsored.fis: None to the State; local impact would depend on how the law is imple- mented by a municipality.

sponsored.t: Requires contractors to recycle waste generated on construction and demolition sites
sponsored.sum: Requires contractors to recycle a certain percentage of the waste generated on construction and demolition sites.
sponsored.fis: The bill should have minimum administrative impacts on State and local government and in fact should reduce waste disposal costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to conducting unlawful surveillance by use of a drone
sponsored.sum: Makes conducting unlawful surveillance by use of a drone unlawful surveillance in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Amends the membership of the New York city water board to include the five borough presidents
sponsored.sum: Amends the membership of the New York city water board to include the five borough presidents, the mayor or a public member appointed by the mayor and a public member appointed by the governor who has experience in the science of water resource development.

sponsored.t: Establishes the renters' and small homeowners' credit in a city with a population of a million or more
sponsored.sum: Establishes the renters' and small homeowners' credit in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state democracy commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state democracy commission to report on certain democracy issues and how to prevent attempts to illegitimately overturn a lawful election on a local, state and federal level.

sponsored.t: Establishes Davina's driver accountability law which requires a uniform curriculum for accident prevention courses; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes Davina's driver accountability law which requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a uniform curriculum for accident prevention courses for use by all sponsoring agencies, delivery agencies and instructors in this state; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York civil rights cold case records collection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York civil rights cold case records collection act; directs the state archivist to create a civil rights cold case records collection; creates the civil rights cold case records review board which shall assist the archivist in the collection of civil rights cold case records.

sponsored.t: Requires cooperative housing corporations provide a prospective purchaser with a written statement of reasons when withholding consent to a purchase
sponsored.sum: Requires cooperative housing corporations provide a prospective purchaser with a written statement of reasons when withholding consent to a purchase; voids any agreement inconsistent with such requirement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study relating to airborne ultrafine particles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study relating to airborne ultrafine particles; analyzes the impacts of certain large hub commercial airports on airborne ultrafine particles; analyzes the characteristics of such particles; identifies effectiveness of mitigation measures.
sponsored.fis: This bill requires the department of transportation and related-agencies to us existing resources.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of information regarding day care services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability of information regarding day care services; requires disclosure of serious injury or death of child upon application for renewal of license.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's caste in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's caste in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits persons named on the consolidated terrorist watchlist from obtaining or renewing a license to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms
sponsored.sum: Prohibits persons named on the No Fly List maintained by the Terrorist Screening Center administered by the Federal Bureau of Investigation from obtaining or renewing a license to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms.

sponsored.t: Withholds the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs
sponsored.sum: Withholds the governor's salary until the legislative passage of the budget occurs; provides such salary should be withheld if the budget has not passed prior to the first day of the fiscal year and shall not be paid until such passage occurs.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring 911 operators to ask callers for the approximate height and weight of the patient
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring 911 operators to ask callers for the approximate height and weight of the patient.

sponsored.t: Relates to the development of uniform standards for the coloring of wind turbine rotor blades
sponsored.sum: Relates to the development of uniform standards for the coloring of wind turbine rotor blades, to avoid or minimize, to the maximum extent practicable, any bird collisions arising from the siting, design, construction and operation of a major renewable energy facility utilizing wind turbines.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing small business tax-deferred savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing small business tax-deferred savings accounts.

sponsored.t: Relates to residential programs for children
sponsored.sum: Relates to residential programs for children and the rights such children have when under such care.

sponsored.t: Relates to high school equivalency diplomas
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a fee for admission to any exam that would award a high school equivalency diploma.

sponsored.t: Requires motor vehicle dealers to disclose price markups to the purchasers of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle dealers to disclose price markups to the purchasers of motor vehicles; provides failure to so disclose shall be grounds for revocation of the dealer's registration and imposes civil liability to purchasers for damages; authorizes the financial frauds and consumer protection unit of the department of financial services to study problematic practices in the price markups of motor vehicle dealers.

sponsored.t: Requires every assessing unit to conduct a revaluation of assessment at least every eight years
sponsored.sum: Requires every assessing unit to conduct a revaluation of assessment at least every eight years.
sponsored.fis: There is a cost associated with the passage of this legislation however the exact figure is not known at this time.

sponsored.t: Relates to additional state payment assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to additional state payment assistance; provides that where there is no agreement in effect for federal administration of additional state payments the commissioner of the office of temporary and disability assistance is responsible for providing assistance to applicants for or recipients of such payments as it relates to applying for, modifying or maintaining such benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of emergency shelter for victims and alleged victims of domestic violence during certain declarations of a state disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Requires certain safety standards for emergency shelter for victims and alleged victims of domestic violence during a declaration of a state disaster emergency for a disease outbreak; requires accommodations in a hotel or motel where a residential facility does not meet safety standards; requires full cost to be assumed by the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of a vehicle as a weapon
sponsored.sum: Relates to the "Heather D. Heyer act" which increases penalties where a vehicle is used as a weapon in a hate crime and makes it illegal to travel upon a roadway in a vehicle within 1000 feet of a protest.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing minimum standards governing maternity policy for institutions employing police officers and correctional officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing minimum standards governing maternity policy for institutions employing police officers and correctional officers including uniform and/or equipment modifications, exemption from firearm qualification requirements, and ensuring there is no discrimination or poor treatment of pregnant individuals.

sponsored.t: Establishes a green new deal for New York task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Green New Deal for New York task force; requires such task force to develop a detailed statewide, industrial, economic mobilization plan for the transition of the New York economy to become greenhouse gas emissions neutral by 2030 and to significantly draw down greenhouse gases from the atmosphere and oceans and to promote economic and environmental justice and equality.
sponsored.fis: The Task Force will use existing staff and resources from relevant state agencies.

sponsored.t: Relates to motorcycle profiling
sponsored.sum: Requires the municipal police training council to ensure that issues related to motorcycle profiling are addressed in basic law enforcement training.

sponsored.t: Requires the sanitation department of the city of New York to provide a photograph of the materials, condition or situation alleged to constitute the violation
sponsored.sum: Requires the sanitation department of the city of New York to provide owners, lessees or persons in charge of a premises at which a violation of the city solid waste disposal law is alleged to have occurred with a photograph of the materials, condition or situation constituting the violation.

sponsored.t: Creates the lupus research enhancement program and the lupus research enhancement fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the lupus research enhancement program; creates the lupus research enhancement fund.

sponsored.t: Authorizes local governments to pay higher levels of minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local governments to pay higher levels of minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Requires the state university of New York and the city university of New York to establish courses of study on ethnic studies, women's studies, and social justice
sponsored.sum: Requires the state university of New York and the city university of New York to establish courses of study on ethnic studies, women's studies, and social justice; requires students to complete at least one three-credit course on ethnic studies, women's studies, or social justice to graduate with a baccalaureate degree.

sponsored.t: Designates the month of September as firefighter, police officer and emergency medical technician appreciation month
sponsored.sum: Designates the month of September as firefighter, police officer and emergency medical technician appreciation month.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the liquor authority from revoking, suspending, or canceling certain liquor licenses without a hearing
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the liquor authority from revoking, suspending, or canceling a retail licensee's license without a hearing when the holder of the license was issued a summons for a violation that is unrelated to the sale or consumption of alcohol on premises.
sponsored.fis: There is no fiscal impact to the State.

sponsored.t: Creates the consumer overdraft protection act
sponsored.sum: Creates the consumer overdraft protection act to ensure that consumers are informed of their options in regard to overdraft protection.

sponsored.t: Relates to water contamination, lead paint and air quality testing in New York city housing authority buildings
sponsored.sum: Relates to water contamination, lead paint and air quality testing in New York city housing authority buildings.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing and reporting acts of harassment at schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to preventing and reporting acts of harassment at schools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the possession and use of cannabis by persons under the age of twenty-one years
sponsored.sum: Prohibits persons under the age of twenty-one years from possessing or using cannabis except for patients certified pursuant to article three of the cannabis law; provides for the seizure of such cannabis from a person under age twenty-one and the imposition of civil penalties, community service, or both for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to petition for expungement of records for certain marihuana convictions
sponsored.sum: Relates to petition for expungement of records for certain marihuana convictions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the distribution and sale of certain lasers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the distribution and sale of certain lasers.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for failure to yield to authorized emergency vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to penalties for failure to yield to authorized emergency vehicles; includes fines and possible imprisonment.

sponsored.t: Increases the trademark registration and renewal fee
sponsored.sum: Increases the trademark registration and renewal fee from fifty dollars to one hundred dollars.

sponsored.t: Increases the remedy for trademark counterfeiting
sponsored.sum: Increases the remedy for trademark counterfeiting by removing the cap and widening the scope.

sponsored.t: Requires climate change education in public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires climate change instruction within the current established science curriculum; requires such instruction be taught in grades one through twelve.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state commission to end mass incarceration and to prevent violence
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state commission to end mass incarceration and to prevent violence; provides such commission shall investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning how to reduce the New York prison population, incidences of violent crime in New York state, and other various topics related to the criminal justice system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of food stamp applications to emergency feeding programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the distribution of food stamp applications to emergency feeding programs.

sponsored.t: Provides for remedies for trademark dilution
sponsored.sum: Provides for remedies for trademark dilution; allows the court, in its discretion, to enter judgment for an amount of three times such profits and damages and/or reasonable attorneys' fees of the prevailing party.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting students made homeless by an act of terrorism or natural disaster to attend the school district in which they resided for two school years after the event
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting students made homeless by an act of terrorism or natural disaster to attend the school district in which they resided for two school years after the event.

sponsored.t: Relates to admissibility of statements obtained from persons under the age of eighteen by means of deception
sponsored.sum: Provides that statements made by minor defendants as a result of deception by law enforcement during custodial interrogation are inadmissible.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing uniform standards for searching for missing persons; expands state databanks to include adults
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Lamont Dottin's Law"; relates to reporting duties with respect to missing children and adults; establishes uniform standards for searching for missing persons; expands state databanks to approach not only the problem of missing children but missing adults as well; requires police departments to establish a trained missing person specialist.

sponsored.t: Enacts the COVID-19 essential workers appreciation act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the COVID-19 essential workers appreciation act which requires businesses who have increased their profits due to the outbreak of COVID-19 to deposit five percent of gross profits into a fund to be used by the COVID-19 essential workers appreciation task force to make awards to essential employees and families of essential employees who have died as a result of contracting COVID-19.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain predatory automated teller machine fees
sponsored.sum: Prohibits predatory automated teller machine fees at casinos and colleges.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state entrepreneurial training act
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Creates the NYS entrepreneurial training act to provide grants to eligible applicants to support and train entrepreneurial candidates.
sponsored.fis: The initial cost to the state will be approximately $5.5 million. Over time, the state will receive additional taxes, including sales and employments taxes, that is undetermined at this time.

sponsored.t: Establishes the commission on public safety, emergency preparedness, and mental health
sponsored.sum: Establishes the commission on public safety, emergency preparedness, and mental health.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reduction of taxes pursuant to shelter rent
sponsored.sum: Provides for a reduction of taxes pursuant to shelter rent to zero percent.

sponsored.t: Enacts the infant vision information, education and wellness program act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Infant Vision Information, Education and Wellness Act; creates the newborn vision screening advisory committee; provides for newborn and infant vision screening; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Allows certain defenses to parking violations despite entering of a default judgment
sponsored.sum: Allows certain defenses to parking violations despite entering of a default judgment.

sponsored.t: Makes an appropriation to reimburse St. John's Episcopal Hospital for costs incurred as a result of remaining open and providing services to the community during and after Hurricane Sandy
sponsored.sum: Makes an appropriation to reimburse St. John's Episcopal Hospital in Far Rockaway for costs incurred as a result of remaining open and providing services to the community during and after Hurricane Sandy.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of health to designate a level one or level two trauma center in Far Rockaway, county of Queens
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of health to designate a level one or level two trauma center in Far Rockaway, county of Queens.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the office of general services to erect a monument to be known as the New York state African slavery and freedom memorial
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of general services to erect a monument to be known as the "New York state African slavery and freedom memorial" in the Governor Nelson A.
