Rockefeller Empire State Plaza to memorialize victims of the African Holocaust, the Holocaust of Enslavement, the Black Holocaust, or the enslavement of Black people and to celebrate the universal values of freedom, democracy and human rights for all people.

sponsored.t: Expands the small business mentoring program
sponsored.sum: Expands the small business mentoring program to include contracts for construction or related services.

sponsored.t: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund to all New York city police officers, firefighters, housing police, transit police, correction officers and registered domestic partners
sponsored.sum: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund to all New York city police officers, firefighters, housing police, transit police, correction officers and registered domestic partners.

sponsored.t: Relates to dispensing certain individuals with opioid reversal drugs upon discharge
sponsored.sum: Requires inpatient facilities to dispense at-risk individuals with opioid reversal drugs upon discharge.

sponsored.t: Provides public assistance for home internet service
sponsored.sum: Provides public assistance for home internet service payments.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state or local police from accepting military surplus equipment from the federal government
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state or local police from accepting military surplus equipment from the federal government.

sponsored.t: Establishes multiple-person accounts; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for multiple-person accounts; requires a signature card; provides that absent indication to the contrary, funds remaining in such an account upon the death of the depositor shall be deemed part of the depositor's estate.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of consumer credit history for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of consumer credit history in hiring, employment and licensing determinations.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 61 Chapter 681 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 3072, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to prohibit- ing the disclosure or use of a person's consumer credit history to an employer, labor organization, employment agency or agent thereof for purposes of employment decisions" APPROVED This bill would prohibit employers, labor organizations, and employ- ment agencies from requesting or using a consumer credit report from an employment applicant. It also prohibits these entities from discriminat- ing against an individual based on information contained within a consumer credit report. While I support the intent of this bill, it required technical revisions for clarity. I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these changes. On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill. This bill is approved.…

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting food stores and retail establishments from refusing to accept payment in cash
sponsored.sum: Prohibits food stores and retail establishments from refusing to accept payment in cash; provides a civil penalty will be assessed for such actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a church, synagogue or other place of worship.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises

sponsored.t: Relates to an exemption from the licensing requirements for servicers of student loans
sponsored.sum: Relates to an exemption from the licensing requirements for servicers of student loans.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to permissible fees in connection with open end loans
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to permissible fees in connection with open end loans from June 30, 2025 until June 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to limiting the check cashing exemption for national banks and other regulated entities
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of provisions relating to limiting the check cashing exemption for national banks and other regulated entities to August 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Establishes expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small and minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Establishes expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small and minority and women-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state cryptocurrency and blockchain study task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state cryptocurrency and blockchain study task force to provide the governor and the legislature with information on the effects of the widespread use of cryptocurrencies and other forms of digital currencies and their ancillary systems, including but not limited to blockchain technology, in the state.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 3403 of the insurance law relating to anti-arson applications
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to mandatory anti-arson applications for insurance coverage to insure any building against the peril of fire or explosion.

sponsored.t: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property
sponsored.sum: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property when covenants, conditions and restrictions exist which discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, familial status, marital status, disability, national origin, source of income or ancestry.

sponsored.t: Relates to private education debt reporting
sponsored.sum: Provides that each student loan servicer shall submit an annual report containing a list of all private education creditors associated with the private education debts serviced by the student loan servicer that are owed by persons who resided in New York during the prior calendar year and containing additional information for each private education creditor reported.
